goal: Extend exact projected-mixture certificates toward full m=8 and then the general LRX conjecture.
invariants: Portfolio miss is not a lower bound
Confirmation data never enters proposer context

facts.statement: For m>=8,r>=2, E_r(m+r)<=T=m(m+1)/2+(r-1)(m-2). Main conjecture remains open. The general r=2 base and universal suitable-word existence are unresolved.

A fixed smaller sorting word with all projection-changing letters has an exact n-position routing DP. Zero-projection repairs use 1--0--(n-1), length at most 2 between projected letters. All terminal j>=m are allowed.
facts.scope: fixed word only; elementary argument, not proof-assistant formalized

facts.statement: For L/X words with k left rotations from initial mark j, the specified greedy repair costs at most 2 floor((k+n-1-j)/(n-2)), conditional on its terminal-position test. This does not establish existence of suitable short words.
facts.scope: L/X-only conditional construction; hard-family words use both directions

facts.statement: For any full word W, marked-zero projection length is |W|-S-I_z, S counting swaps of two zeros, I_z its boundary carries and swaps with positives. This audits a word; it does not construct one.
Old A_P<=P+m-2 is false: m8r3 vector (2,1,0,0,0,7,8,6,5,4,3), P42,A42=49; m9r3 vector (2,1,0,0,0,9,8,7,6,5,4,3),P52,A52=61. Use Q=T(m,r-1), projection q=Q+1 and full bound B=Q+m-2.
facts.scope: refutes stronger old lifting claim, not original conjecture

facts.statement: Six fixed geodesic priority orders yield A54<=58 on 27 m8r5 antipode insertions and A77<=83 on 346 m8r9 antipode insertions. This covers special families only.
facts.scope: finite development examples, not exhaustive graphs

facts.statement: The m9r3 obstruction is repaired by one level step and suitable descents (projection53,length59). The m8r3 witness has projection43,length47 with an uphill step at projection index5 from distance36 to37. Static-priority prefixes/suffixes miss that m8 repair: descent choices must coordinate with routing.
Alternating or distance-dependent priority orders, paired with a controlled detour, may coordinate descents with zero routing. Test reusable policies; do not encode individual vectors.
Supplied manuscript establishes d(v)<=6n-18 for m=8, all 8! orders, and positive blocks in all nine linear gaps including both endpoints. Its complete mixture data passed our independent exact audit.
facts.scope: Computer-assisted nine-gap class for all positive lengths, relying on the reviewed comparison/stretching lemmas; not a formal proof assistant result or full m=8.

facts.statement: Recompute mixtures after projection instead of reusing the nine-gap weights. Seek weighted base <31+6k and each retained slope <=6. A new valid mixture certifies all positive lengths in that family.
facts.scope: Search priority; no newly covered projected family has been found in this session. Reported remaining-family count depends on coverage not fully re-audited here.

facts.statement: For the stated separated-label class, every single fixed tagged standard macro-lift has some slope >=2 floor(m/2), exceeding m-2. A portfolio of words can evade this obstruction.
facts.scope: Manuscript flow lemma; excludes adaptive word choice and does not refute the conjecture. Reviewed mathematical argument, not a graph-model formalization.

facts.statement: Exact new mixtures certify all positive lengths for 52 of 100 frozen m=8 development families with 4–8 retained blocks. 39 use inherited supports; 13 add compatible existing catalog words. Old inherited weights fail the base bound on these cases. A wider existing-catalog search is the next cheap hypothesis.
facts.scope: Named development families, using the reviewed comparison/stretching lemmas. No confirmation results included. No verified global union increment or full m=8 proof.
